info.title: HoneyForge Backend
info.description: Management API and internal telemetry ingestion. Public registration always grants user role. Email login uses Bearer JWT. Profiles are shared templates; only administrators modify them. Servers and traps are owner-scoped. The server bootstrap endpoint installs an agent through Center over SSH; ordinary server registration and desired trap state do not deploy anything. Port reservations are exclusive per registered server/protocol/port; dispatcher backends use distinct TCP ports. Pritvoryashka telemetry uses an independent opaque bearer token, validates trap/server ownership and is stored idempotently in PostgreSQL.

Center-to-PostgreSQL mirror. The trusted center supplies agent identity and
event; the backend resolves server ownership from the registered trap.
Internal agent endpoint. The bearer token is independent from user JWTs.

AttackEvent.description:
Internal canonical record, created only after sender/trap authorization.
On retries storage MUST reuse the first persisted record and its timestamps.

KozyavkaRuntimeConfig.description: Exact JSON accepted by honeyforge-low --config. Identity and port are derived.

host_inventory.description:
Latest typed inventory reported by the authenticated agent. The JSON schema version is
carried inside this object so the panel can evolve independently.

credential_ref.description: Opaque reference scoped to the authenticated user; never an SSH key/password.

host.description: DNS hostname or IP literal, without URL scheme, credentials or port.
